name: WCCM Czech Republic (Křesťanská meditace)
reason: No usable photo and thin current content: krestanskameditace.cz has no logo or picture of a place of its own (only venue photos of a Broumov guesthouse and parish buildings), its news looks stale (latest dated item 2023; the Broumov weekend of 27-29 Nov gives no year), leaving a Monday online group and translated texts.
